title: BLove
altText: Stunning oriental pop surrealism graffiti mural by Mr Blob, featuring a surreal wild boar character in a floating temple holding a staff next to a smiling anthropomorphic strawberry against a fiery pagoda sunset.
description: Created for the Draw the Line festival in Campobasso, this mural stages an oriental pop-surrealist scene: a tusked wild boar peers out from a floating temple palanquin, gripping a staff from which a hatted rodent dangles above a grinning anthropomorphic strawberry. Fiery skies and distant pagoda silhouettes complete the storybook atmosphere, painted entirely in freehand spray.
